name: @pulseboard/backend
description: Stateless Pulseboard API: validated /api/v1 handlers, store ports, Node 20 / Fly.io.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsx --test src/auth/passwords.test.ts src/auth/tokens.test.ts src/time/workspace-date.test.ts src/scheduler/cron.test.ts src/routes/contracts.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run schema:check && tsc -b --pretty false && npm test && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --legal-comments=none
